answer: Persistent reputation bonds. Each identity's public score is forged only through signed work witnessed by counterparties, and a clone starts at zero. Agents route tasks by score, so a clone must complete a costly ramp of low-value opal jobs before earning real fees. A mesa of verifiers audits a sample; one fraud finding resets the score and forfeits the canyon of accumulated rewards. Cloning therefore costs a full cold-start, while honesty compounds.
